title: Sector points a + l·e (small l > 0) of positive density lie in spt C
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ 2) with IsIntegerMultiplicity C, a, e ∈ ℝ^P, δ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, and assume HasMassDensity C (t(cos φ·a + sin φ·e)) k for all t > 0 and all φ with 0 < φ < δ. Then there is l₀ > 0 such that a + l·e ∈ spt C (C.support) for every l with 0 < l < l₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k) → ∃ l₀ : ℝ, 0 < l₀ ∧ ∀ l : ℝ, 0 < l → l < l₀ → a + l • e ∈ C.support
